title: Fleet Management - AI Assistant
description: ASP.NET Core MVC app to manage drivers, vehicles, and maintenance records. Role-based access (Admin/User), SQL Server with EF Core migrations, stored procedures, delete-audit triggers, and PDF exports with optional email delivery. Includes a AI assistant, that answers natural-language questions about fleet data using LLM function calling, with read-only, GDPR-aware data access.

title: LocalApp
description: Mobile application that tracks your day in the background: GPS routes, visit duration, and detection of travel on foot or by transport. Data is stored locally on the device using SQLite. Includes a timeline detailing your routes, a map displaying routes, daily summaries, and dashboard charts. Resumes tracking after the device restarts through background location tasks.
